_________BT.TestAgent Version 1.0.45.0 ___________

Usage as prompted console app :
> testagent  --pat "...." 

Usage as single call command execution :
> testagent  --pat "...." --command --p1 "...."  --p2 "...." 

Parameter Options

  parameter values can be given with or without double quotes.¬
  Neither commands nor parameter names are case sensitive¬
  parameter values signified with their type i.e.,¬
  bool should be replaced with true or false,¬
  int should be replaced with an integer value,¬
  string should be replaced with an quoted string value etc.
  Arrays should be written either [int,int,int] or int,int,int format.

ToolMode 

  --pat            Personal Authentication Token
  --command        One of the TestAgent commands
  --p1             First parameter's name for the command if required
  --p2             Second parameter's name for the command if required

  clear/clr/cls    Clear screen

  exit/quit        Quits the application

AssignWorkItemToUser
     Description   Assigns the WorkItem to the given user
     Usage exp     AssignWorkItemToUser --workItemId int --userEmail string
     Returns       Help || ParameterMissing || Aborted || Success || Exception

CheckTagsLocal
     Description   Checks the tags for files in a local directory.
     Usage exp     CheckTagsLocal --path string 
     Returns       Help || ParameterMissing || NotFound || Success || Exception

CloneTestCase
     Description   Clones a Test Case to a Test Suite
     Usage exp     CloneTestCase --sourceTestCaseId int --sourceTestSuiteId int --sourceTestPlanId int --destTestSuiteId int --destTestPlanId int
     Returns       Help || ParameterMissing || Aborted || Success || Exception

CloneTestSuite
     Description   Clones a Test Suite as a child to another Test Suite, Copy All Suites=true, DeepClone=true
     Usage exp     --sourceSuiteId int --destSuiteId int
     Returns       Help || ParameterMissing || Success || Exception

DeleteTestCase
     Description   Deletes the given Test Case by Id
     Usage exp     Dele
